_source: Core Rulebook, Cleric: Domains — the seven druid domains from d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/cleric/domains/paizo-domains (read 2026-10-04); the other twenty-six from legacy.aonprd.com/coreRulebook/classes/cleric.html (read 2026-10-05, War checked word for word against d20pfsrd). A druid who takes a domain through nature bond uses her druid level as her cleric level for these powers (Core Rulebook, Druid: Nature Bond).
_grammar: Each power is a document read by rules/grantedpowers.py (its module docstring is the grammar): `level` is the class level it arrives at; `pool` declares uses per day, spent through `cost`; `tags` and `modifiers` hold while the power is had, and `by_level` lays the rung for a higher level over it; `feats` and an entry's `class_skills` are handed over; `action`, `attack`, `effect`, `save`, `toggle` and `tell` say what USING it does, in the class-ability grammar (rules/class_abilities.py); `not_yet` says, out loud, what the engine has no reader for. Validated on load by rules/domains.py:validate_powers.

powers.name: Lightning Arc
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 electricity + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Electricity Resistance
powers.line: Resist electricity 10, 20 from 12th, immunity at 20th.

powers.name: Speak with Animals
powers.line: Speak with animals, as the spell, for 3 + your level rounds a day.
not_yet: Spending a round: there is no op that runs a spell-like ability by rounds, so the pool is counted and the talking is the GM's.

powers.name: Animal Companion
powers.line: An animal companion from 4th level, at an effective druid level of your level - 3: choose it on the Class tab when 4th level asks (the class's "domain companion" choice, which holds the -3).

not_yet: Knowledge (nature) as a class skill (Core Rulebook text for the Animal domain): class skills are read off the class document only.

powers.name: Artificer's Touch
powers.line: Mending at will; or a melee touch against an object or construct for 1d6 + 1 per two levels, ignoring hardness and DR up to your level, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Objects and their hardness: nothing in a scene but a creature has hit points yet, so the touch reaches constructs only (content/class-abilities/domains.json).

powers.name: Dancing Weapons
powers.line: Touch a weapon: it gains the dancing quality for 4 rounds; once a day at 8th, once more for every four levels beyond.
not_yet: A weapon fighting on its own: there is no dancing-weapon actor yet.

powers.name: Touch of Chaos
powers.line: Melee touch: for a round the target rolls every d20 twice and takes the worse, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Rolling twice and keeping the worse: no d20 reader takes a second roll yet, so the touch is counted and the misfortune is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Chaos Blade
powers.line: Touch a weapon: it gains the anarchic quality for half your level in rounds; once a day at 8th, once more for every four levels beyond.
not_yet: The anarchic quality on the weapon: a weapon property granted for rounds has no reader yet, so the uses are counted and the blade's new edge is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Dazing Touch
powers.line: Melee touch: a living creature is dazed for a round (none with more Hit Dice than your level), 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Charming Smile
powers.line: Charm person as a swift action (Will DC 10 + half your level + Wis), one creature at a time, for your level in rounds a day.
not_yet: The charm itself: a spell-like ability that runs by rounds has no op, so the rounds are counted and the charm is the GM's (the mind gate refuses an attitude change without an origin).

powers.name: Calming Touch
powers.line: Touch: heal 1d6 + your level in nonlethal damage and lift fatigued, shaken and sickened, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Unity
powers.line: Immediate action: allies within 30 ft use your saving throw against an effect that targets you all; once a day at 8th, once more for every four levels beyond.
not_yet: Lending a save: the save op rolls each creature's own.

powers.name: Blind-Fight
powers.line: Blind-Fight as a bonus feat.

powers.name: Touch of Darkness
powers.line: Melee touch: for half your level in rounds the target treats everyone as having concealment (20% miss chance), 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: A miss chance laid on the target's own attacks: concealment is read off the defender, and no effect yet makes everyone concealed from one attacker.

powers.name: Eyes of Darkness
powers.line: See normally in any darkness, magical or not, for half your level in rounds a day.
not_yet: Turning the sight on by rounds: no op spends a power by rounds yet.

powers.name: Bleeding Touch
powers.line: Melee touch: a living creature takes 1d6 a round for half your level in rounds (until a DC 15 Heal check or any healing), 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The bleeding: damage each round is a periodic effect, and periodic damage has no executor yet (docs/states-effects-tells.md, Promised).

powers.name: Death's Embrace
powers.line: Channelled negative energy heals you instead of harming you.

powers.name: Destructive Smite
powers.line: Declare before a single melee attack: + half your level (min +1) as a morale bonus on its damage, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Destructive Aura
powers.line: A 30-ft aura for your level in rounds a day: every attack against a creature in it gains + half your level morale damage, and its critical threats confirm.
not_yet: Attacks against creatures inside an aura: a bonus to the attacker that depends on where the defender stands has no reader yet.

powers.name: Acid Dart
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 acid + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Acid Resistance
powers.line: Resist acid 10, 20 from 12th, immunity at 20th.

powers.name: Touch of Evil
powers.line: Melee touch: the target is sickened for half your level in rounds (min 1), 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Counting the target as good for spells with the evil descriptor: no spell reads an alignment, by the 2026-09-19 ruling.

powers.name: Scythe of Evil
powers.line: Touch a weapon: it gains the unholy quality for half your level in rounds; once a day at 8th, once more for every four levels beyond.
not_yet: The unholy quality on the weapon: a weapon property granted for rounds has no reader yet, so the uses are counted and the blade's new edge is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Fire Bolt
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 fire + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Fire Resistance
powers.line: Resist fire 10, 20 from 12th, immunity at 20th.

powers.name: Glorious Channel
powers.line: When you channel positive energy to harm undead, the save DC to halve it rises by 2.

modifiers.note: read by Channel Energy's harm mode (`bonus_from`)

powers.name: Touch of Glory
powers.line: Touch: + your level on one Charisma-based skill or Charisma check within the hour, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: A bonus spent on the next roll of a kind: no effect yet ends itself when it is used.

powers.name: Divine Presence
powers.line: A 30-ft aura for your level in rounds a day: allies inside are under sanctuary (Will DC 10 + half your level + Wis).
not_yet: Sanctuary on allies: the ward that stops attackers has no reader for an aura yet.

powers.name: Touch of Good
powers.line: Touch: + half your level (min +1) sacred bonus on attacks, saves, skill and ability checks for a round, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The bonus on ability checks: no roll reads an ability check yet (attacks, saves and skills take it).

powers.name: Holy Lance
powers.line: Touch a weapon: it gains the holy quality for half your level in rounds; once a day at 8th, once more for every four levels beyond.
not_yet: The holy quality on the weapon: a weapon property granted for rounds has no reader yet, so the uses are counted and the blade's new edge is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Rebuke Death
powers.line: Touch a living creature below 0 hit points: heal 1d4 + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Healer's Blessing
powers.line: Your cure spells heal half again as much (as Empower Spell; not against undead, and not stacking with it).
not_yet: Empowering the cure: the cast op rolls a spell's dice as its prose says and reads no tag of the caster's.

powers.name: Lore Keeper
powers.line: Touch a creature: learn of it as if you made the Knowledge check with a result of 15 + your level + Wis.
not_yet: Learning of the creature: the knowledge check is the GM's; the book gives this touch no limit a day.

powers.name: Remote Viewing
powers.line: Clairvoyance/clairaudience at will for your level in rounds a day.
not_yet: Scrying by rounds: no op spends a power by rounds yet.

powers.name: Touch of Law
powers.line: Touch a willing creature: for a round every d20 it rolls counts as an 11, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Fixing the d20 at 11: no roll reads a set face yet.

powers.name: Staff of Order
powers.line: Touch a weapon: it gains the axiomatic quality for half your level in rounds; once a day at 8th, once more for every four levels beyond.
not_yet: The axiomatic quality on the weapon: a weapon property granted for rounds has no reader yet, so the uses are counted and the blade's new edge is the GM's to narrate.

powers.name: Liberation
powers.line: For your level in rounds a day, move as under freedom of movement; it starts on its own when you are held.
not_yet: Slipping magical holds: freedom of movement has no reader yet, so the rounds are counted and the escape is the GM's.

powers.name: Freedom's Call
powers.line: A 30-ft aura for your level in rounds a day: allies inside ignore confused, grappled, frightened, panicked, paralyzed, pinned and shaken.
not_yet: Suppressing conditions for allies in an aura: no aura effect exists yet.

powers.name: Bit of Luck
powers.line: Touch a willing creature: for a round it rolls every d20 twice and keeps the better, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Rolling twice and keeping the better: no d20 reader takes a second roll yet.

powers.name: Good Fortune
powers.line: Immediate action: reroll a d20 you just rolled and take the second; once a day at 6th, once more for every six levels beyond.
not_yet: The reroll: an immediate action after a roll has no op yet.

powers.name: Vision of Madness
powers.line: Melee touch for 3 rounds: + half your level on attacks, saves or skill checks (your pick) and - half your level on the other two, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Choosing which of the three is raised: a choice of overlays on a touch is not written for this power yet.

powers.name: Aura of Madness
powers.line: A 30-ft aura for your level in rounds a day: enemies inside are confused unless they save (Will DC 10 + half your level + Wis); one that saves is immune for a day.
not_yet: The day's immunity for a creature that saved, and confusion ending when it leaves the aura: no aura tracks who stands in it.

powers.name: Hand of the Acolyte
powers.line: Your melee weapon flies 30 ft to strike as a thrown weapon, Wis instead of Dex on the attack, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The flying strike: an attack with a melee weapon at range, rolled off Wis, has no field yet.

powers.name: Dispelling Touch
powers.line: Melee touch: a targeted dispel magic; once a day at 8th, once more for every four levels beyond.
not_yet: The dispel: a caster-level check against a spell's effect has no op for a power yet.

powers.name: Inspiring Word
powers.line: One creature within 30 ft: +2 morale on attacks, saves, skill and ability checks for half your level in rounds (min 1), 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The bonus on ability checks: no roll reads an ability check yet (attacks, saves and skills take it).

powers.name: Leadership
powers.line: Leadership as a bonus feat, +2 to your Leadership score while you keep your faith's tenets.
not_yet: The +2 Leadership score and followers: no cohort is modelled.

powers.name: Wooden Fist
powers.line: Fists hard as wood for 3 + Wis rounds a day: lethal, no attack of opportunity, + half your level to damage (min +1).
not_yet: Turning the fists on: a toggled power needs a `toggles` row, and those are read off a class path only (rules/leveling.py, another lane's file). The rounds are counted; the damage bonus does not land yet.

powers.name: Bramble Armor
powers.line: Thorns for your level in rounds a day: a foe striking you unarmed or without reach takes 1d6 piercing + 1 per two levels.
not_yet: The thorns striking back: there is no on-being-hit trigger to hang the damage from.

powers.name: Divine Protection
powers.line: +1 resistance bonus on saving throws, +1 more for every five levels.

powers.name: Resistant Touch
powers.line: Touch an ally: it takes your resistance bonus for a minute and you lose it, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Moving your bonus to the ally: suspending one of your own passives for a minute has no field yet.

powers.name: Aura of Protection
powers.line: A 30-ft aura for your level in rounds a day: you and allies inside gain +1 deflection to AC (+1 per four levels beyond 8th) and resist 5 acid, cold, electricity, fire and sonic (10 at 14th).
not_yet: The book names no action to raise the aura; a standard action is assumed.

powers.name: Gentle Rest
powers.line: Melee touch: a living creature is staggered for a round (asleep if already staggered); undead are staggered for Wis rounds, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Sleep for a creature already staggered, and Wis rounds against undead: the touch lands its one-round stagger only.

powers.name: Ward Against Death
powers.line: A 30-ft aura for your level in rounds a day: living creatures inside are immune to death effects, energy drain and negative levels.
not_yet: Immunity granted to others by an aura: no aura effect exists yet.

powers.name: Scribe Scroll
powers.line: Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat.

powers.name: Blast Rune
powers.line: An invisible rune in an adjacent square: whoever enters it takes 1d6 + 1 per two levels of acid, cold, electricity or fire; lasts your level in rounds, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The rune as a trap on a square: a hazard laid by a power has no op yet.

powers.name: Spell Rune
powers.line: Attach a spell you cast (a level below your highest) to a blast rune.
not_yet: Waits on the blast rune above.

powers.name: Strength Surge
powers.line: Touch: + half your level (min +1) enhancement on melee attacks, Strength-based combat manoeuvres, skills and checks for a round, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Strength checks: no roll reads an ability check yet. Melee attacks, CMB, Climb and Swim take the bonus.

powers.name: Might of the Gods
powers.line: + your level as an enhancement bonus to Strength checks and Strength skills, for your level in rounds a day.
not_yet: A bonus on Strength checks only (not attacks or damage): the funnel has no 'Strength check' target.

powers.name: Sun's Blessing
powers.line: When you channel positive energy to harm undead, add your level to the damage; undead add no channel resistance.
not_yet: Channel resistance: no creature in the app carries any yet, so there is none for undead to lose.

modifiers.note: read by Channel Energy's harm mode (`bonus_from`)

powers.name: Nimbus of Light
powers.line: A 30-ft nimbus of daylight for your level in rounds a day: undead inside take your level in damage each round; darkness spells brought in are dispelled.
not_yet: Damage each round to undead in an aura: periodic damage has no executor yet.

powers.name: Swift Traveller
powers.line: +10 ft base speed.

powers.name: Agile Feet
powers.line: Free action: ignore difficult terrain for a round, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: Ignoring difficult terrain: movement cost on the map does not read a tag yet.

powers.name: Dimensional Hop
powers.line: Move action: teleport up to 10 ft per level a day, in 5-ft steps, without provoking.
not_yet: The hop: the pool counts feet, and spending feet to move has no op yet.

powers.name: Copycat
powers.line: Move action: an illusory double, as one mirror image, for your level in rounds, 3 + Wis times a day.
not_yet: The image soaking an attack: mirror images have no reader yet.

powers.name: Master's Illusion
powers.line: Veil yourself and any allies within 30 ft for your level in rounds a day (Will DC 10 + half your level + Wis to disbelieve).
not_yet: The veil: a disguise worn by a group has no reader yet.

powers.name: Battle Rage
powers.line: Touch: + half your level (min +1) on melee damage for a round, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Weapon Master
powers.line: Swift action: the use of one combat feat you qualify for, for your level in rounds a day.
not_yet: Borrowing a feat for rounds: feats are read off the feat list, and a feat lent for a time has no field yet.

powers.name: Icicle
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 cold + 1 per two levels, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Cold Resistance
powers.line: Resist cold 10, 20 from 12th, immunity at 20th.

powers.name: Storm Burst
powers.line: A ranged touch at a foe within 30 ft: 1d6 nonlethal + 1 per two levels and -2 to its attacks for a round, 3 + Wis times a day.

powers.name: Lightning Lord
powers.line: Your level in bolts a day, as call lightning, any number in one standard action.
not_yet: The bolts themselves: call lightning's damage is not resolved from a domain power yet.
